notes.title: GAROU MARK OF THE WOLVES NETCODE OVERHAUL
notes.content:
[h1]Are you okay?[/h1]

[h2][b]BUSTER WOLF!![/b][/h2]

Get ready to enjoy one of SNK's most popular fighting games, GAROU: Mark of the Wolves, now with enhanced netcode and bug fixes!


This new update includes:
[list]
[*]New and improved port for Steam based on the PS4 release
[*]New achievements
[*]New leaderboards
[*]Code Mystics' unique Rollback netcode (previously featured in SSVS/KOF97)
[*]Fixes in both sound and visual desync
[*]Automatic or user-defined netcode settings
[/list]


For more information on Code Mystics' netcode and how to tune the options, please check out this video explaining the process!
[previewyoutube=1JHetORRpfQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey, come on! What are you waiting for! Blast away your friends with a buster wolf TODAY!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Changelog of v.1.0.1:
- Fixed Terry Bogard's command list
- Fixed bug when changing video settings during online multiplayer play
- Fixed issues with Pause menu
- Minor bug fixes in menus

Thank you for playing  GAROU: MotW on Steam!

Additional future updates are coming soon for an even better game experience. Stay tuned GAROU fans!
